text:
Priya (CS): Heads-up — account Arcturus pushed live yesterday and now we see an unexpected token tail after their onboarding demo. Looks like sustained embed + gen usage outside normal hours. Can we triage before QBR?

Sam (CSE): Weird pattern: spikes every ~15m for 6h. Could be a cron misconfiguration. Quick grep: `awk -F' ' '$1 ~ /2026-03-19/ && /arcturus/ {print $0}' /var/log/inference.log | wc -l` -> 3600 lines.

Mei (Finance): If that continues, monthly estimate balloons by ~25k USD. For the QBR I need a 3-scenario projection (status quo, corrected ingestion, worst-case repeated). Can someone generate a 30-day extrap with confidence bounds?

Lucas (Solutions): I'll ask the customer if they scheduled any automated syncs. Also ask them to pause the pipeline until we say otherwise. Priya — any enablement sessions with Arcturus this week?

Priya (CS): We had an enablement 1:1 yesterday afternoon. I'll note the pause in the follow-up email and capture customer feedback about confusing default webhook retries.

Sam (CSE): Immediate mitigations: flip on per-account request sampling, add a temporary 6k tokens/minute cap, and enable dedupe on payload_id. OpsBot can you set sampling and cap?

OpsBot: /run set-sampling --account arcturus --rate 10% --reason "triage activation noise"

OpsBot: /run set-rate-cap --account arcturus --tokens-per-minute 6000 --reason "activation triage"

OpsBot: Results: sampling and rate cap applied.

Mei (Finance): Good. Please export hourly tokens for the last 96h so I can build a scenario table. Preferred format CSV with columns: hour_ts,tokens,requests,model.

Sam (CSE): `rw billing export --account arcturus --hours 96 --format csv --fields hour_ts,tokens,requests,model > /shared/arcturus_tokens_96h.csv` — dropping now.

Lucas (Solutions): Customer response: they had a k8s cronjob mis-pointing to prod endpoint during dev ramp. They will roll back and redeploy a corrected job. They asked if we can provide a temporary one-time onboarding credit for the excess.

Priya (CS): Add that to the QBR asks: "requested 1x onboarding credit (supporting docs attached) + joint checklist for safe ramp". Also capture feedback: clearer examples for webhook/dedup in docs.

Sam (CSE): Root cause summary for ticket: client cron -> prod endpoint + missing idempotency header -> retries multiplied by network flakiness. I'll open a CL with suggested server-side idempotency and a small SDK backoff doc update.

Mei (Finance): With current remediation, create three slides: base (pre-spike), corrected (expect 90% of base), and credit ask (net impact with proposed 1x credit). I'll aim to have numbers by 18:00 PT.

OpsBot: Monitoring: token rate down 82% after rate-cap and customer rollback (2026-03-19T21:42:10Z). Continuing to watch for 2h.

Priya (CS): Action items: - Sam: postmortem & PR for dedupe/idempotency - Lucas: confirm rollback and get customer quote for QBR - Mei: slides + scenario CSV analysis - Priya: update QBR asks, attach exported CSV and customer quote.

Sam (CSE): Will update ticket 5421 with notes and attach logs.

Lucas (Solutions): Got the quote. Short customer line: "We accidentally pointed our sync job to prod during ramp — appreciate the quick assist and proposed runbook." I'll drop it in the QBR doc.

Mei (Finance): Received CSV link. Working on scenario table now. If we recommend credit, I'll propose the amount and include it as a one-time adjustment in the deck.

Priya (CS): Thanks all. Let's re-check after the 2h watch window and finalize numbers for the QBR. :v:
